failure_reason: Site has a real, deep Pet Care taxonomy (confirmed via homepage nav JSON and PLP sitemap), but exact product counts (qty) are unattainable via any permitted route: Meesho's PLP pages are Next.js shells whose real product grid/totalProductsCount is populated by a client-side XHR after hydration (raw SSR payload shows totalProductsCount:0 on every category page checked), and the likely count/facet endpoints (*/facet_clp/*, */search) are robots.txt-disallowed -- identical platform-wide limitation to the prior Home-Decor pass on this same site. In addition, curl_cffi (impersonate=safari17_2_ios, the only profile that worked in the prior pass) started returning 403 after ~17 sequential requests mid-session (Akamai/WAF), so per the 'first block stops that host' rule further verification fetches (titles/breadcrumbs/counts for the remaining candidate URLs) were halted before every row could be independently confirmed.
notes: Access: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked first). curl_cffi impersonate='safari17_2_ios' returned real SSR HTML (200) for homepage, /dog-collars-harnesses-leashes/pl/6755, and /pet-supplies/pl/1nht; a subsequent batch of 17 breadcrumb-verification fetches all returned 403 (WAF) -- stopped requesting the host at that point per the brief's first-block rule, and used only what had already been fetched. Two independent sources of Pet Care structure were found: (1) the homepage's embedded 'nav.navUrls' JSON (a flat, curated list of ~362 top-level shop-by-category tiles covering the whole site) contains exactly 6 pet items with real titles: Collars & Leashes (/dog-collars-harnesses-leashes/pl/6755), Clothes & Grooming (/pet-grooming/pl/9ug), Food & Treats (/pet-food/pl/9uf), Aquarium Accessories (/aquarium-accessories/pl/21j0), Pet Toys (/interactive-toys-for-pets/pl/90f), Pet Bowls (/feeding-bowls-for-pets/pl/9af) -- these titles are CONFIRMED (rendered nav text). (2) The permitted /sitemap.xml -> /sitemap/plp/0.xml (category-listing sitemap, 19046 URLs total) contains ~35 additional dog/cat/pet-specific PLP URLs in a contiguous slug/id range (671y-679r) reading as coherent English category names (e.g. 'apparel-accessories-for-dogs/6757', 'litter-housebreaking-for-pets/674z', 'health-supplies-for-pets/6759', 'houses-kennels-pens/679r'); one of these (dog-collars-harnesses-leashes/6755) was independently breadcrumb-confirmed and its real title ('Dog Collars, Harnesses & Leashes', parent breadcrumb 'Pet Supplies') matches its slug almost exactly, giving reasonable confidence the sibling slugs in that same ID range are similarly literal -- but their titles were NOT independently fetched/confirmed before the 403 block hit, so each is flagged. Excluded from this range as likely non-navigable attribute/material-variant PLPs (same pattern as Meesho's color-variant carpet pages, e.g. 'teal-carpets'): metal-collars-for-dogs, stainless-steel-collars-for-dogs, dry-food-for-dogs, dry-food-for-cats, dog-leashes, dog-harnesses, dog-collars, cat-leashes, cat-collars, chew-toys-for-dogs, litter-for-cats, aquarium-lights, aquarium-decor, 5x shampoo-for-pets variants, dog-clothes/clothes-for-dogs/clothes-cats, dog-stuffed-toys/cats-stuffed-toys, exercise-balls-for-pets -- these look like children of the confirmed leaf rows below rather than separate top-level categories; not enumerated to avoid inventing an unverified 3rd tier. Also excluded as pet-themed-not-pet-care: 'lions-other-big-cats-stuffed-toys' (kids' stuffed-animal toy, not a pet product), 'english-cat-books'/'paperback-cat-books' (books about cats), 'petticoats'/'carpets'/'cateye-sunglasses'/collar-* clothing items (false-positive substring matches on 'pet'/'cat'). Breadcrumb taxonomy is internally inconsistent across the two confirmed fetches (Pet Supplies appears as id=42/type=cat/parent=null on one page and id=195/type=scat/parent=28('Home Improvement') on another) -- typical of Meesho's dual search-vs-catalog classification; not resolved, doesn't affect row identity. Treated /pet-supplies/pl/1nht as the department root/grouping row (mixed roll-up page, category_type scat with s_id filter only) rather than a leaf, consistent with prior pass's 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad' practice. No overlap with other categories claimed (Furniture/Storage/Textile workers would not touch dog/cat-specific beds, collars, carriers). Absence check n/a -- Pet Care is clearly present and substantial on this site.
